content: 第四关（前）

speaker: Amiya
content: ...It's getting darker and darker.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   It's as if the clouds are pressing into the skyline...
speaker: Amiya
content: It's as if the clouds are pressing into the skyline...

raw: [name="Amiya"]   The air still feels clear, but the dark clouds aren't moving. It feels like all the stress is being compressed into a single point.
speaker: Amiya
content: The air still feels clear, but the dark clouds aren't moving. It feels like all the stress is being compressed into a single point.

speaker: Amiya
content: Even the wind has stopped...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  No doubt about it. A Catastrophe is about to befall this city.
speaker: Dobermann
content: No doubt about it. A Catastrophe is about to befall this city.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  By the looks of things, Chernobog has been completely paralyzed by Reunion's attacks.
speaker: Dobermann
content: By the looks of things, Chernobog has been completely paralyzed by Reunion's attacks.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  But when it comes to disabling a nomadic city, the preparations must have been made several weeks in advance.
speaker: Dobermann
content: But when it comes to disabling a nomadic city, the preparations must have been made several weeks in advance.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Could Reunion have taken some other action since then...?
speaker: Dobermann
content: Could Reunion have taken some other action since then...?

speaker: Ace
content: That's a bit unrealistic.

raw: [name="Ace"]   Based upon what we've seen, Reunion currently doesn't show the kind of discipline required to stage a covert takeover.
speaker: Ace
content: Based upon what we've seen, Reunion currently doesn't show the kind of discipline required to stage a covert takeover.

raw: [name="Guard"]   Most Reunion members are still wandering the streets, taking revenge on Chernobogians.
speaker: Guard
content: Most Reunion members are still wandering the streets, taking revenge on Chernobogians.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   It's all just senseless fighting, killing, and arson.
speaker: Amiya
content: It's all just senseless fighting, killing, and arson.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  When the Catastrophe falls, even the impregnable Chernobog will be shattered...
speaker: Dobermann
content: When the Catastrophe falls, even the impregnable Chernobog will be shattered...

speaker: Dobermann
content: ...and turn into Originium-filled ruins.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  If fame or fortune is what they're after, Reunion is doomed to failure.
speaker: Dobermann
content: If fame or fortune is what they're after, Reunion is doomed to failure.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   Even with Ursus's chain of command in shambles, I still doubt that Reunion is able to face their military...
speaker: Amiya
content: Even with Ursus's chain of command in shambles, I still doubt that Reunion is able to face their military...

raw: [name="Amiya"]   Why hasn't the Ursus military staged a counterattack yet?
speaker: Amiya
content: Why hasn't the Ursus military staged a counterattack yet?

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  From my experience, when a riot breaks out, the military usually manages to quash it immediately.
speaker: Dobermann
content: From my experience, when a riot breaks out, the military usually manages to quash it immediately.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  But we did just witness the Ursus guards getting overpowered...
speaker: Dobermann
content: But we did just witness the Ursus guards getting overpowered...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  That masked Reunion leader might have been a cut above the rest... but there's no way she could single-handedly destroy the entire city.
speaker: Dobermann
content: That masked Reunion leader might have been a cut above the rest... but there's no way she could single-handedly destroy the entire city.

speaker: Dobermann
content: Unless...

speaker: Amiya
content: Unless what?

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  I've fought in many battles before...
speaker: Dobermann
content: I've fought in many battles before...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  I've seen many people who acted in the same way as that Reunion leader.
speaker: Dobermann
content: I've seen many people who acted in the same way as that Reunion leader.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  To them, soldiers are nothing more than pawns to be tossed away as soon as they've served their purpose.
speaker: Dobermann
content: To them, soldiers are nothing more than pawns to be tossed away as soon as they've served their purpose.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Soldiers could be used efficiently when needed, and then left to their own devices when not needed.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Soldiers could be used efficiently when needed, and then left to their own devices when not needed.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Because the cost of training and maintenance is too high.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Because the cost of training and maintenance is too high.

speaker: Ace
content: So, there's no standing army?

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Right. Most of the time, they simply have to be fed with some hatred or fear...
speaker: Dobermann
content: Right. Most of the time, they simply have to be fed with some hatred or fear...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  All that's needed to whip them into a frenzy... is a little push.
speaker: Dobermann
content: All that's needed to whip them into a frenzy... is a little push.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  If the way that Reunion leader acted was any indication for how the organization is run...
speaker: Dobermann
content: If the way that Reunion leader acted was any indication for how the organization is run...

speaker: Guard
content: Ugh...

raw: [name="Guard"]   Any Infected could join Reunion simply by donning a uniform and putting on a badge?
speaker: Guard
content: Any Infected could join Reunion simply by donning a uniform and putting on a badge?

speaker: Dobermann
content: Correct..

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  So... that explains their endless numbers.
speaker: Dobermann
content: So... that explains their endless numbers.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  There are too many oppressed Infected, desperately trying to cry out. No matter how tenuous the solutions that Reunion offers them might be...
speaker: Dobermann
content: There are too many oppressed Infected, desperately trying to cry out. No matter how tenuous the solutions that Reunion offers them might be...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  As long as they see a light at the end of the tunnel, they will gladly lay their lives down to pursue it, even if it means jumping into a sea of hellfire.
speaker: Dobermann
content: As long as they see a light at the end of the tunnel, they will gladly lay their lives down to pursue it, even if it means jumping into a sea of hellfire.

speaker: Medic
content: Ugh...

speaker: Dobermann
content: Dr. {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  They are not like us. Even if I don't fully trust you, I at least trust your abilities.
speaker: Dobermann
content: They are not like us. Even if I don't fully trust you, I at least trust your abilities.

speaker: Dobermann
content: And completely unlike you...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  That kind of leader is no commander.
speaker: Dobermann
content: That kind of leader is no commander.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Those who would trample enemies and comrades alive... or rather, 'minions.'
speaker: Dobermann
content: Those who would trample enemies and comrades alive... or rather, 'minions.'

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Perhaps not even minions. To Reunion, those thugs may have been nothing more than pawns.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Perhaps not even minions. To Reunion, those thugs may have been nothing more than pawns.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  This is not a leader, but a tyrant.
speaker: Dobermann
content: This is not a leader, but a tyrant.

raw: [name="Ace"]   No matter who our enemies are, we will complete our mission.
speaker: Ace
content: No matter who our enemies are, we will complete our mission.

raw: [name="Ace"]   Someone once taught me and my teammates--
speaker: Ace
content: Someone once taught me and my teammates--

raw: [name="Ace"]   'If facing a pawn, capture it; If facing a fortress, topple it; If facing the Crown, overthrow it.'
speaker: Ace
content: 'If facing a pawn, capture it; If facing a fortress, topple it; If facing the Crown, overthrow it.'

speaker: Dobermann
content: Ace, wait a minute.

raw: [name="Ace"]   Dr. {@nickname}, enemy light-armored troops are stationed in front of us.
speaker: Ace
content: Dr. {@nickname}, enemy light-armored troops are stationed in front of us.

speaker: Amiya
content: Have we been found?

speaker: Ace
content: Not yet.

speaker: Dobermann
content: However...

raw: [name="Ace"]   We won't be able to avoid them. The route we're on is the shortest one; if we take a detour, we'll lose time we don't have.
speaker: Ace
content: We won't be able to avoid them. The route we're on is the shortest one; if we take a detour, we'll lose time we don't have.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  No need for further discussion then. Thugs or pawns, all that matters is that we clear them out of our way!
speaker: Dobermann
content: No need for further discussion then. Thugs or pawns, all that matters is that we clear them out of our way!
